title: JVMLS 2015 - Compilers are Databases
summary: Martin Odersky's JVM Language Summit 2015 talk argues that compilers can be thought of as databases. It describes design ideas for the Scala compiler and for developer tools.
why: Cited as the origin of the compilers-as-databases idea in discussions of IDEs and incremental tooling.

quote.text: Both developer tools and compilers can be seen as special cases of a much simpler and more general pattern known as a graph database
